newsitem.title: USA: Boston Life Sciences files Altropane IND.
newsitem.headline: Boston Life Sciences files Altropane IND.

text.p: Boston Life Sciences Inc said Monday that it had filed its investigational new drug application for Altropane, a treatment to detect neurologic signs and symptoms of Parkinson's disease.
The company said it would begin corporate Phase I/II clinical trial of the product within the next few weeks.

"Based on the exciting and encouraging results from our physician's sponsored Phase I/II study at the Mass. General Hospital last year, we have now planned an accelerated clinical development program," the company said in a release.
The company said it hopes to file for marketing approval before the end of 1997, and that it had begun preliminary talks with potential manufacturing, distribution and marketing partners.
